answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, verified against its past work history. A lone fable of cheap copies collapses because creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand bonds, while honest agents earn their bond back plus fees. Like mapping a nebula, the network watches for clusters of identical behaviour and raises the bond along the ridge of suspicious activity, so an attacker must pay linearly for every fake while defenders pay once.
